title: Can I IGNORE Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess while NOT knowing his own drawback (paper covers it; viewers see it). Goal: win a single game; ends 2 for 3, correctly deducing his drawbacks (e.g. Eat Your Vegetables, Even Keeled).
rules: Standard setup; each player gets one secret random drawback (with hard drawbacks enabled); opponent's drawback is revealed after the game.
No check/checkmate: kings can be captured; moving into check is legal; capturing the enemy king wins.
If your drawback makes you have no legal moves / you violate a lose-condition drawback, you lose.
The site highlights moves your drawback requires.
Player's own drawback hidden from the player (the 'Ignore' twist); the site still highlights required moves / blocks illegal ones.

Drawbacks seen: Eat Your Vegetables (you can't capture non-pawns until your opponent only has 4 pawns remaining), Even Keeled (you can only capture on even-numbered moves), plus guesses: 'You can only capture non-king pieces eight times', 'can't capture non-pawn pieces with the same piece type'.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king / opponent loses by drawback. Goal: 1 win (got 2 of 3).

board.theme_notes: Drawback Chess site: brown/tan board on dark purple-navy UI (#2b2758 / #302a66); right panel shows your drawback card text with 'hide drawback' and 'reveal drawback to opponent' buttons, Easy-Hard difficulty slider; opponent anonymous names in red ('lazy orange monkey'), clocks with +2 increment

current_impl_issues: Legacy uses checkmate; king-capture needed. The hidden-own-drawback flag (show:false) is correct; pool should include Eat Your Vegetables and Even Keeled.
